 begin

 from set_inventory_levels
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and customer_id = :standard
 and product_type = :avail_products.product_type

 and inventory_type = :minimal

 exception

 end;
 --
 -- get optimal inventory
 begin
 select qty into :avail_products.s_optimal
 from set_inventory_levels
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and customer_id = :standard
 and product_type = :avail_products.product_type
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and inventory_type = :optimal
 and attrib_code is null;

 'Y','Years', 'Days'),

 :avail_products.time_unit

 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);

Item.Name: S_ON_ORDER
Item.Comment: products on order for this tier

Trigger.Name: PRE-BLOCK
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 :s_total_in_stock := 0;
 :s_total_on_order := 0;
 :s_total_allocated := 0;
 :s_total_packed := 0;
 :s_total_available := 0;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_frday number;
 temp_today number;
 temp_count number;
begin
 :avail_tiers.s_time_unit := :avail_products.s_life_span_desc;
 temp_frday := :avail_tiers.from_day * :avail_products.time_unit;
 temp_today := :avail_tiers.to_day * :avail_products.time_unit;
 --
 -- count the number of ordered products
 --
 select nvl(sum(required_qty),0)
 into :avail_tiers.s_on_order
 from order_items
 where product_type = :avail_products.product_type
 and item_status not in (:canceled, :closed)
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and tier = :avail_tiers.tier
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id;
 :s_total_on_order := :s_total_on_order + :avail_tiers.s_on_order;
 --
 -- get amount allocated from active products
 --
 --Modified for both scheme to coexist
 select count(*) into :avail_tiers.s_allocated
 from active_products 
 where product_type = :avail_tiers.product_type
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and blood_type in (SELECT abo_label
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE tested_abo_code in ( SELECT tested_abo_code 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type ) AND
 identifier_code in ('RG','EM','DE','AE') ) 
 and stock_state = :allocated
 and (trunc(exp_date - sysdate)
 between temp_frday and temp_today);
 :s_total_allocated := :s_total_allocated + :avail_tiers.s_allocated;
 --
 -- get all products marked as packed from active products
 --
 --Modified for both scheme to coexist
 select count(*) into :avail_tiers.s_packed
 from pick_slip_products
 where product_type = :avail_tiers.product_type
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and blood_type in (SELECT abo_label
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE tested_abo_code in ( SELECT tested_abo_code 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type ) AND
 identifier_code in ('RG','EM','DE','AE') ) 
 and product_status = :packed
 and (trunc(exp_date - sysdate)
 between temp_frday and temp_today);
 :s_total_packed := :s_total_packed + :avail_tiers.s_packed;
 --
 -- get total inventory available
 --
 select count(*) into :avail_tiers.s_in_stock
 from active_products
 where product_type = :avail_tiers.product_type
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and (trunc(exp_date - sysdate)
 between temp_frday and temp_today);
 --
 -- add products out of date range to max tier
 if :avail_tiers.tier = :avail_products.max_tier
 then
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from active_products
 where product_type = :avail_tiers.product_type
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_0.blood_type
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_0.chapter_id
 and (trunc(exp_date - sysdate) > temp_today);
 :avail_tiers.s_in_stock := :avail_tiers.s_in_stock + temp_count;
 end if;
 --
 -- add them up
 :s_total_in_stock := :s_total_in_stock
 + :avail_tiers.s_in_stock;
 --
 :avail_tiers.s_available := :avail_tiers.s_in_stock
 - :avail_tiers.s_allocated
 - :avail_tiers.s_on_order;
 --
 :s_total_available := :s_total_available
 + :avail_tiers.s_available;
 hilite;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
